stories.headline: Anthropic Ships Claude Code Channels, Letting Developers Message AI Agent via Discord and Telegram

key_facts.fact: Anthropic announced Claude Code Channels on March 20 as a research preview in Claude Code v2.1.80+, enabling developers to connect their AI coding agent to Discord and Telegram messaging platforms for asynchronous interaction.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, Anthropic announced Claude Code Channels, a way to hook up its own powerful Claude Code AI agentic harness to a human user's Discord or Telegram messaging applications, letting them message Claude Code directly whenever they want while on the go and instruct it to write code for them.

key_facts.fact: Channels are MCP servers that act as two-way bridges, pushing events into running Claude Code sessions so Claude can react to external triggers and reply through the same channel even when the developer is away from the terminal.
key_facts.excerpt: A channel is an MCP server that pushes events into your running Claude Code session, so Claude can react to things that happen while you're not at the terminal. Channels can be two-way: Claude reads the event and replies back through the same channel, like a chat bridge.

key_facts.fact: The feature is a direct competitive response to OpenClaw, the viral open-source autonomous AI agent created by Peter Steinberger (later hired by OpenAI) that gained rapid developer adoption by offering persistent AI messaging via multiple chat platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: The update gives Claude Code the same approach that made OpenClaw popular, but with the security and ease of use of a commercial product.

key_facts.fact: Claude Code sessions can now run in a background terminal or persistent server, with developers receiving mobile notifications when tasks complete. MacStories confirmed the Telegram integration is already 'very capable' despite research preview status.
key_facts.excerpt: Late yesterday, Anthropic announced messaging support for Claude Code, allowing users to connect to a Claude Code session running on a Mac from a mobile device using Telegram and Discord bots. I spent a few hours playing with it last night, and despite being released as a research preview, the messaging integration is already very capable.

stories.headline: Xiaomi Reveals Mystery 'Hunter Alpha' as MiMo-V2-Pro, a 1T-Parameter Model at 1/6th the Cost

key_facts.fact: Xiaomi confirmed that 'Hunter Alpha,' the anonymous model that topped OpenRouter's usage charts after appearing on March 11, was its MiMo-V2-Pro — a 1-trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 42 billion active parameters and up to 1 million token context window.
key_facts.excerpt: Within days, this anonymous model processed over one trillion tokens, climbed to the top of OpenRouter's usage charts, and left thousands of developers wondering the same thing: who built this, and why are they hiding? The answer, when it finally came a week later, surprised almost everyone. Hunter Alpha was not from DeepSeek... It was built by Xiaomi.

key_facts.fact: MiMo-V2-Pro is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $3 per million output tokens (up to 256K context), roughly one-sixth to one-seventh the cost of GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6 while approaching frontier-level benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: performance benchmarks are said to be approaching those of OpenAI and Anthropic but at roughly one-sixth to one-seventh of the cost when accessed through its API

key_facts.fact: The project was led by Fuli Luo, a 31-year-old researcher who previously worked on the DeepSeek R1 project that rattled markets. Luo described the launch on X as 'a quiet ambush on the global AI frontier' and confirmed plans to open-source a variant.
key_facts.excerpt: led by Fuli Luo, who previously worked on DeepSeek R1 project — the Chinese AI model that shook the industry and cost Nvidia billions of dollars in market cap in a day... describing it in a post on X as 'a quiet ambush' on the global AI frontier

key_facts.fact: Before the reveal, many experts suspected Hunter Alpha was DeepSeek-V4. The model processed 1.27 million requests and over 1 trillion tokens on OpenRouter, reaching approximately 500 billion tokens per week at peak usage.
key_facts.excerpt: experts initially thought it was DeepSeek-V4, the expected successor to the cost-effective models of DeepSeek

key_facts.fact: Alongside MiMo-V2-Pro, Xiaomi launched MiMo-V2-Omni (multimodal model supporting text, images, video, audio at $0.40/$2.00 per million tokens) and MiMo-V2-TTS (text-to-speech with emotion control). Xiaomi stock surged 5.8% on the reveal.
key_facts.excerpt: Xiaomi stock surge: 5.8% on reveal announcement... R&D investment commitment: $5.6 billion

stories.headline: Anthropic Files Court Declarations Revealing Pentagon Was 'Nearly Aligned' Before Trump Cut Ties

key_facts.fact: Anthropic submitted two sworn declarations to a California federal court on Friday March 20, challenging the Pentagon's assertion that the company poses an 'unacceptable risk to national security' over its AI safety guardrails.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic submitted two sworn declarations to a California federal court late Friday afternoon, pushing back on the Pentagon's assertion that the AI company poses an 'unacceptable risk to national security' and arguing that the government's case relies on technical misunderstandings and claims that were never actually raised during the months of negotiations that preceded the dispute.

key_facts.fact: The declarations were filed by Sarah Heck (Head of Policy, former Obama-era National Security Council official) and Thiyagu Ramasamy (Head of Public Sector), arguing the government's case relies on technical misunderstandings never raised during months of negotiations.
key_facts.excerpt: The two people who submitted the declarations are Sarah Heck, Anthropic's Head of Policy, and Thiyagu Ramasamy, the company's Head of Public Sector. Heck is a former National Security Council official who worked at the White House under the Obama administration.

key_facts.fact: The filings reveal the Pentagon had told Anthropic the two sides were 'nearly aligned' just one week before President Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth publicly cut ties after Anthropic refused to allow unrestricted military AI use.
key_facts.excerpt: The dispute traces back to late February, when President Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth publicly declared they were cutting ties with Anthropic after the company refused to allow unrestricted military use of its AI technology.

key_facts.fact: The dispute centers on a roughly $200 million AI contract. A hearing is scheduled for Tuesday March 24 before Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco.
key_facts.excerpt: Amid heated negotiations over a $200M AI contract, the Pentagon and Anthropic clash on critical guardrails against mass surveillance and autonomous weapons.

stories.headline: WordPress.com Enables AI Agents to Write and Publish Content via MCP Server Update

key_facts.fact: WordPress.com announced on March 20 the launch of write capabilities for its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling AI agents including Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to create, edit, and manage site content through natural conversation.
key_facts.excerpt: WordPress.com, Automattic's hosted website platform built on the open source WordPress software, today announced the launch of new write capabilities for its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The update enables AI agents — including Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor — to create, edit, and manage content on WordPress.com sites directly through natural conversation, on behalf of users.

key_facts.fact: AI agents can now draft and publish blog posts, edit existing content, manage comments, update and fix metadata, and organize content with tags and categories — all on a platform that publishes 70 million new posts per month.
key_facts.excerpt: it will now allow AI agents to draft, edit, and publish content on customers' websites, as well as manage comments, update and fix metadata, organize content with tags and categories

key_facts.fact: All actions require explicit user confirmation before execution; the MCP server is opt-in with nothing enabled by default. The feature is available on all paid WordPress.com plans at no additional cost.
key_facts.excerpt: Automattic has added write capabilities to WordPress.com's MCP integration, giving AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT the ability to create posts, build pages, manage comments, and restructure content, all through natural conversation, with human approval at every step.

key_facts.fact: The update expands the read-only MCP server WordPress.com launched in October 2025, which initially gave AI agents only passive access to site content and analytics.
key_facts.excerpt: For most of the past six months, connecting an AI agent to your WordPress.com site has meant giving it a window. You could ask Claude or ChatGPT questions about your content, pull up site analytics, or check which posts hadn't been updated in a year. Useful, but fundamentally passive. On Friday, Automattic added a door.

stories.headline: Starling Bank Launches UK's First Agentic AI Banking Assistant Powered by Google Gemini

key_facts.fact: Starling Bank rolled out Starling Assistant to personal account holders on March 20, billing it as the UK's first agentic AI financial assistant — one that can execute banking tasks directly rather than just analyzing and reporting data.
key_facts.excerpt: The UK challenger bank is rolling out Starling Assistant to personal account holders today, billing it as the UK's first agentic AI financial assistant.

key_facts.fact: The assistant can set up savings goals, organize bill payments, manage direct debits, set up spending categories, analyze transaction history, and generate spending quizzes — all from voice or text prompts.
key_facts.excerpt: It can set up savings goals, organise bill payments, and even quiz you on your own spending, all from a voice or text prompt.

key_facts.fact: Built on Google Gemini on Google Cloud, with all customer data remaining within Google Cloud's environment and not used for model training. The system is opt-in only.
key_facts.excerpt: Starling Bank has been building methodically towards this moment for the better part of a year. In June 2025 it became the first UK bank to put a natural language AI interface over customer spending data.

key_facts.fact: Group chief executive Raman Bhatia called agentic AI 'the next step in banking.' Business and joint account support will follow the personal account rollout.
key_facts.excerpt: Starling launches an AI banking assistant that actually does things

sources.title: Starling launches an AI banking assistant that actually does things

stories.headline: Google Pursues Pentagon AI Contracts, Reversing 2018 Military Abstention Amid Anthropic Clash

key_facts.fact: The New York Times reported on March 20 that Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian met with Emil Michael, the Pentagon official overseeing AI tool selection, to pitch Google as an expanded defense AI partner — reversing its 2018 decision to abstain from military work after the Project Maven controversy.
key_facts.excerpt: Google Cloud CEO Thomas sat down with Emil Michael, the Pentagon official in charge of selecting AI tools for the Defense Department to pitch the company as defense partner.

key_facts.fact: Google already has existing business with the Pentagon. Kurian offered a 'reliable, expanded supply of some of the best AI tools on the market,' positioning Google to fill the gap left by the Anthropic-DoD dispute.
key_facts.excerpt: Google which had reportedly decided to abstain from military work in the year 2018 is now rebuilding its relationship with the Defense Department.

key_facts.fact: CNBC reported on March 20 that despite Google management pursuing Pentagon contracts, many Google employees have sided with Anthropic in the Defense Department battle over AI ethics and military use restrictions.
key_facts.excerpt: Google pursues Pentagon contracts as employees side with Anthropic in Defense Department battle

stories.headline: Nature Biotechnology Publishes Roadmap for Autonomous Biological AI Discovery Systems

key_facts.fact: Nature Biotechnology published a major review on March 20 outlining the path to Generalist Biological AI (GBAI) — comprehensive systems that can concurrently interpret, generate, and predict across DNA, RNA, proteins, and cellular systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Generalist biological artificial intelligence (GBAI) represents a transformative approach to modeling the 'language of life' — the flow of information from DNA to cellular function. This Review synthesizes rapid advances in biological AI to interpret and generate DNA, RNA, proteins and cellular systems.

key_facts.fact: The review identifies AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery as a key frontier, alongside synergizing language and structural AI models to create end-to-end biological reasoning systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Substantial opportunities lie in synergizing language and structural AI, leveraging specialized models and improving AI agents for autonomous discovery.

key_facts.fact: The authors envision GBAI deepening understanding of disease pathways and biomarkers, advancing automated therapeutic design, and integrating within virtual cells to simulate biological activity at scale.
key_facts.excerpt: GBAI has the potential to deepen our understanding of disease pathways and biomarkers, advance automated therapeutic design and evaluation, and integrate within virtual cells to meaningfully simulate biological activity.

sources.title: Generalist biological artificial intelligence in modeling the language of life
